texts.en:
The planet the drones were protecting is tidally locked, one side facing the cold darkness of space, and the other bathed in perpetual light. On the warm, light-filled half of this world we uncovered the ruins of what may be a Vagrosian city.

Keides trusts that details of his past are buried here, and hopes the findings might reveal the planet's history.

This site must be excavated by Keides himself.

sections.en:
The planet the drones were protecting is tidally locked, one side facing the cold darkness of space, and the other bathed in perpetual light. On the warm, light-filled half of this world we uncovered the ruins of what may be a Vagrosian city.

Keides trusts that details of his past are buried here, and hopes the findings might reveal the planet's history.

This site must be excavated by Keides himself.

texts.zh: 这颗行星在瓦格罗社会中一定扮演了至关重要的角色。在挖掘初期，很明显，大部分基础设施都以行政工作为中心，这座城市可能是一个通信枢纽。这里还有许多领导层碰面的地方，而且已经发现了几个极大规模的公共广场。
texts.en: The planet must have played a vital role in the Vagrosian society. Early into the excavations, it has become clear that much of the infrastructure was centered around administrative work, the city potentially serving as a hub for communications. There was no shortage of places for those in leadership to gather, and several public squares of truly massive proportions have already been uncovered.

texts.zh:
因为很幸运地发现了一座地下保险库，凯德斯兴奋得几天没睡着。他确信这个地方就隐藏着自己身世的秘密。

在保险库的深处，他发现了一排又一排的冷冻仓，但里面都是空的。集成在地板上的电路连向了一座更大的结构：在拱顶的中心有一个像王座一样的基座。
texts.en:
Thanks to the fortunate discovery of an underground vault, Keides has not slept for days. He is convinced that this place holds the key to his existence.

Deep within the vault, he discovered row upon row of cryostasis pods, all of them empty. Circuits integrated in the floor led to a larger structure: a throne-like pedestal at the very center of the vault.

label.zh: 真有意思。这是干什么用的？

texts.zh:
不顾科学小组的抗议，凯德斯毅然决定坐上那台王座般的机器。

他刚一坐下来就失去了知觉。

尽管他的表情变得放松，但他的身体却承受着剧烈的痉挛。科学小组再怎么努力也没能把他从王座上解救出来。几个小时过去了。最后，就在他年轻的身体似乎再也无法承受的时候，凯德斯醒了。他的报告即将发表。
texts.en:
Against the protestations of the science team, Keides made the decision to sit upon the throne-like machine.

No sooner had he sat down, he lost consciousness.

Even as his expression slackened, his body was wracked by convulsions. No amount of effort from the science team was able to free him from the throne. Hours passed. Finally, just when it seemed his young body could bear no more, Keides awoke. His report is forthcoming.

texts.zh:
凯德斯看到了一座广场。广场上有成百上千个人。

大家面朝天空，看着一艘巨大的飞船从大气层外徐徐降落。就在此时一个声音响起：

“听着”它说，“审判之日就要到了。楔将会被夺走。你们应留在此地，直到一切的终结。”

人们的哭喊震耳欲聋。在他的幻视中，凯德斯意识到他的星球已经被抛弃了。他们的主人，一个拥有难以想象的力量的外星物种，发现他的人民缺乏潜力。楔（及其产生的虫洞）是连接他的星球和更广阔的星系的唯一途径。一旦与星系贸易切断往来，他的人民繁荣的基础就无可挽回地丧失了。
texts.en:
Keides saw a public square. Packed inside it were thousands, if not hundreds of thousands of people.

Faces turned to the sky, they watched as a massive ship descended from the upper atmosphere. At once a single voice boomed out.

'Attend,' it said. 'For the time of judgment is at hand. The Keys will be taken. Here you shall remain, until the end of all things.'

The cries of the people were deafening. In the midst of his vision, Keides understood that his world had been abandoned. Their masters, an off-world species of unimaginable power, had found his people lacking. The Keys (and the stable wormholes they produced) were all that connected his world to the wider galaxy. Cut off from galactic trade, the foundation of his people's prosperity was suddenly, and irretrievably, lost.

texts.zh:
作为怜悯，瓦格罗人被宽限一个月内交出所有楔和相关材料。事实上，这与其说是怜悯，不如说是侮辱，因为这点时间根本不够他们自救。作为一颗行政管理行星是没有办法维持其庞大人口的。他们所能期望的最好结果就是定量配给他们所拥有的食物，让自己能晚一点挨饿。他们在外面的主人当然了然于胸。

然而，即使在绝望中，这颗星球的领袖也想出了一个计划。最近对高级冷冻保存和基因组学的试验结果基于了给了他们一个不一定能成功的机会。
texts.en:
As a mercy, the Vagrosians were given a month to yield all Keys and related materials. In truth, it was more insult than mercy and not nearly sufficient to save themselves. As an administrative world, the planet did not have the means to sustain its vast population. The best they could hope for was to ration what they had, delaying the time of their starvation. Their off-world masters were well aware of this.

However, even in their despair, the planet's leaders hatched a plan. Recent forays into advanced cryopreservation and genomics had afforded them an unlikely opportunity.

label.zh: 他们没有在沉默中死亡。肃然起敬。
label.en: So, they would not go quietly. Commendable.

texts.zh:
当瓦格罗人的求生计划开始实施时，包含他们未来的“子嗣”凯德斯被发射到太空中，同时被发射的还有他们最后一个楔的碎片，它被分解成四块，四散到星系各处以避免被发现。凯德斯出生时就没有父母，而是基因工程的产物。他的DNA中包含着对他的族人的记忆。当他成年时，只要接触到楔就可以通过幻视来获取这些记忆。

除了这个计划，这个行星的领袖还下令建造数千个冷冻舱和巨大的地下空间来容纳它们。在那里，最聪明的瓦格罗人可以一直休眠，等待“子嗣”的归来。他们确实如此，直到低温冷冻也无法继续支撑他们的身体。他们心智化为数据，在王位里等待着子嗣的归来。
texts.en:
As the Vagrosian survival plan was set into motion, the pod containing their would-be 'Scion' Keides was launched into space - and with it, a fragment of their last Key, broken into four pieces and sent across the galaxy to avoid detection. Keides was born without parents, the product of genetic engineering. Encoded within his very DNA lay the memories of his people. Upon his maturity, contact with the Key would allow him to access these memories in the form of visions.

Alongside this plan, the planet's leaders ordered the construction of thousands of cryostasis pods and the giant underground space to house them. There, the brightest Vagrosian minds could sleep, awaiting the Scion's return. And so they had, until the cryostasis could no longer support their bodies. Minds reduced to data, they waited for their Scion inside his throne.

texts.zh:
为了不让他们白白牺牲，凯德斯再次坐回到子嗣王座上。结果这一次事情很快并且一点也不剧烈地就完成了。他的人民的记忆就像溪水一样平静地涌进他的脑海。

有了他祖先的知识和记忆，挖掘工作很快就结束了。凯德斯的下一步行动是处理所有获得的数据，然后撰写报告。
texts.en:
So as not to squander their sacrifice, Keides once more sat upon the Scion's throne. This time it proved a shorter and less dramatic affair. The memories of his people entered him with the tranquility of a flowing stream.

With his ancestors' knowledge and memories in hand, the excavation was shortly concluded. Keides's next course of action is to process all the obtained data and then report back.

label.zh: 很好。我们期待他的汇报。

texts.zh:
凯德斯的耷拉着肩，失去了一贯的活力。最近的事件似乎让他倍感疲惫。不过，他依然面带释然的微笑。

我得到了答案。其中有好有坏，但我很高兴找到了它们。
texts.en:
Keides's shoulders are slumped, his usual vigor diminished. It would seem recent events have taken their toll. Still, he wears an easy smile.

I have my answers. They may be bittersweet, but I am glad to know them.

label.zh: 你没有让列祖列宗丢脸。

label.en: And now? What will you do?

label.zh: 让科学继续成为你心头的那团火吧。
我们的军队需要你的智慧。
我们的人民需要你的管理。
